column5: 17 zones: ParkGO zones Ia and Ib, five BgA car parks, resident concept Stadthalle (zone 132) and its three Parkscheininseln (street_paid), six TU campus areas. Not zoned: resident zones 120B (Helmstedter Strasse) and 330B (TU Hauptcampus), where resident streets alternate with unrestricted free streets so a whole-quarter resident zone would overstate costs (follow-up: street-level digitisation); the permit districts A/B/C, which overlay Ia/Ib (exemption of permit holders not modelled); ParkGO zone II apart from the Parkscheininseln, and the part of zone Ia south of the city's zone-map extent: both are drawn on the ParkGO annex map, published on page 3 of 2_08_Parkgebuehrenordnung_2025.pdf, but not digitised in v1 because the annex could not be georeferenced to an RMS of 10 m or better, and the rule-based construction of v2 lever 1 (2026-09-30) yields no core there (parking_zones_2026_qa.csv), nor was the majority rule over the parking supply of v2 Amendment B applied: its pre-registered validation B5 failed at the share 0.5, and at the owner's post hoc share 0.3 (owner decision 2) the holdout check H2 failed (parking_zones_2026_supply_share_qa.csv); BgA car park Willy-Brandt-Platz (in zone II, no matching outline); TU Volkmaroder Strasse (ticketed from 2026-10-01, no outline) and Bevenroder Strasse (not ticketed). Park-and-ride car parks are free (parken-in-der-innenstadt.php).
1 zone: Lebenstedt centre. Salzgitter-Bad has disc parking only (2 h), no fees (same page).
1 zone: Innenstadt (Norden, Mitte, Sueden). Outside the zone: Fallersleben (fee-tagged car parks in OSM, not audited).
